# Keynote Support

> > Comprehensive tutorials for Excel spreadsheets and accounting fundamentals designed to help small businesses track and manage financial data effectively.

Keynote Support, founded by Pat Kearns, provides beginner-friendly tutorials covering Excel formulas, functions, data visualization, and accounting principles. The site emphasizes practical, step-by-step guidance for small business owners and accounting students learning to use Microsoft Excel and accounting concepts.

## Key Topics

- Excel formulas
- Conditional formatting
- Excel functions (IF, SUMIF, AVERAGE, COUNTIF)
- Accounting basics
- Debits and credits
- Data visualization
- Chart types
- Date functions
- Data linking
- Account types
- General Ledger
- Chart of Accounts
- Spreadsheet formulas
- Microsoft Excel
- Small business accounting

## Excel Fundamentals

- [Excel Basics tutorials - Keynote Support](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-basics): Main hub for Excel basics tutorials covering formulas, charts, and data linking
- [Excel Made Easy: a Beginner's Guide - Keynote Support](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-basics/excel-for-beginners-guide.shtml): Beginner guide to Excel workbooks and worksheets with step-by-step instructions
- [How to Link Data in Excel Worksheets & Workbooks!](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-basics/excel-linking-worksheets.shtml): Tutorial on linking cells and data between Excel worksheets and workbooks
- [How to Fill a Column, Row, Range with the Same Data in Excel](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-basics/excel-autofill-how-to-fill-row-column-range-same-value.shtml): Tutorial on autofill and copying values across columns and rows in Excel

## Excel Functions & Formulas

- [Menu of Popular Excel Functions :: Keynote Support](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-functions): Reference menu for popular Excel functions like IF, SUMIF, AVERAGE, COUNTIF
- [How to Use the IF Function of Microsoft Excel](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-functions/if-function.shtml): Tutorial on using IF function for conditional logic in Excel spreadsheets
- [The 10 Best Examples of the SUMIF Function of Excel](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-functions/sumif-function-excel.shtml): Tutorial with 10 examples of using SUMIF function for conditional summing in Excel
- [Two Ways to Write Percentage Formulas in Excel](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-basics/how-to-write-percentage-formulas-in-excel.shtml): Tutorial on writing and formatting percentage formulas in Excel spreadsheets
- [Excel: The Best Way to Calculate Age in Years - Keynote Support](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-basics/date-how-to-calculate-age-excel-best-way.shtml): Tutorial on calculating age in years using YEARFRAC and date functions in Excel

## Excel Formatting & Data Visualization

- [Excel Chart Types: Pie, Column, Line, Bar, Area, and Scatter](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-basics/excel-chart-types.shtml): Tutorial on Excel chart types and when to use pie, column, line, and bar charts
- [How to Conditionally Format with Color Scales - Keynote Support](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-format/excel-conditional-formatting-color-scales.shtml): Guide to conditional formatting with color scales and gradients in Excel
- [Excel Conditionally Formatting - Aging >30, >60 and >90 Days](https://www.keynotesupport.com/excel-format/excel-conditional-formatting-aging-30-60-90-days-old.shtml): Tutorial on conditional formatting for aging analysis in accounts receivable

## Accounting Essentials

- [Accounting Tutorials for Beginners - Keynote Support](https://www.keynotesupport.com/accounting): Main hub for accounting tutorials covering debits, credits, and financial reports
- [Accounting Basics: Assets, Liabilities, Equity, Revenue, and Expenses](https://www.keynotesupport.com/accounting/accounting-assets-liabilities-equity-revenue-expenses.shtml): Tutorial on accounting account types: assets, liabilities, equity, revenue, expenses
- [Accounting: Making Sense of Debits and Credits!](https://www.keynotesupport.com/accounting/accounting-basics-debits-credits.shtml): Accounting tutorial explaining debits and credits with practical examples

## Software & Technology

- [Excel Tutorial Menu :: Learn the Basics :: Keynote Support](https://www.keynotesupport.com/software): Tutorial menu for software programs including Windows and Microsoft Office
- [Using the Internet :: Tutorial Menu](https://www.keynotesupport.com/internet): Tutorial menu for internet topics including HTML, Unicode, and internet safety
